Most desserts are about indulgence. Nothing Bundt Cakes is built around something more lasting: occasions. For nearly 30 years, customers have turned to the brand to mark life's biggest moments, from birthdays and holidays to graduations and gatherings. \r\n This episode of "Here's the Deal" looks at our investment in Nothing Bundt Cakes, the largest specialty bakery franchisor in the U.S., with approximately 800 bakeries spanning 45 states and Canada. \r\n Beyond the frosting is a business model we're drawn to: durable, repeatable, and remarkably resilient. The operating model is simple, and demand is tied to occasions that we believe hold up through the economic cycle. The result is a steady, recurring demand that looks less like a typical dessert concept and more like a subscription business. \r\n What drew us in as a partner is how much growth is already baked in and how much we can help bring to life: a largely contracted pipeline of more than 600 signed-but-not-yet-opened bakeries, meaningful room to deepen relationships through a sharper digital experience, and significant opportunity as national awareness catches up to the devotion of its fans. It's a reminder that some of the most compelling businesses are sitting in plain sight. \r\n Watch the episode to see how the deal came together. \r\n"}}" id="text-2b44d0d83d"> Most desserts are about indulgence. Nothing Bundt Cakes is built around something more lasting: occasions. For nearly 30 years, customers have turned to the brand to mark life's biggest moments, from birthdays and holidays to graduations and gatherings.

Beyond the frosting is a business model we're drawn to: durable, repeatable, and remarkably resilient. The operating model is simple, and demand is tied to occasions that we believe hold up through the economic cycle. The result is a steady, recurring demand that looks less like a typical dessert concept and more like a subscription business.

What drew us in as a partner is how much growth is already baked in and how much we can help bring to life: a largely contracted pipeline of more than 600 signed-but-not-yet-opened bakeries, meaningful room to deepen relationships through a sharper digital experience, and significant opportunity as national awareness catches up to the devotion of its fans. It's a reminder that some of the most compelling businesses are sitting in plain sight.

Watch the episode to see how the deal came together.

대부분의 디저트는 탐닉을 이야기한다. Nothing Bundt Cakes는 그보다 오래가는 것, 바로 '기념할 만한 순간'을 중심으로 만들어졌다. 거의 30년 동안 고객들은 생일과 명절, 졸업식, 모임에 이르기까지 인생의 가장 큰 순간을 기념하기 위해 이 브랜드를 찾았다. 
 이번 "Here's the Deal" 에피소드에서는 미국 최대 전문 베이커리 프랜차이저 Nothing Bundt Cakes에 대한 우리의 투자를 다룬다. 이 회사는 미국 45개 주와 캐나다에 걸쳐 약 800개의 매장을 운영하고 있다. 
 프로스팅 너머에는 우리가 끌린 비즈니스 모델이 있다. 내구성이 높고, 반복 가능하며, 놀라울 만큼 회복력이 강하다. 운영 모델은 단순하고, 수요는 경기 사이클 내내 견조하게 유지된다고 우리가 보는 기념일·행사와 맞물려 있다. 그 결과 꾸준하고 반복적인 수요가 형성되며, 이는 전형적인 디저트 콘셉트라기보다 구독 사업에 가깝다. 
 파트너로서 우리를 끌어당긴 것은 이미 얼마나 많은 성장이 내재해 있는지, 그리고 우리가 얼마나 더 키워낼 수 있는지였다. 계약이 대부분 확정된 600개 이상의 계약 체결·미개점 매장 파이프라인, 더 정교한 디지털 경험을 통해 고객 관계를 심화할 수 있는 상당한 여지, 그리고 팬들의 충성도를 전국적인 인지도가 따라잡으면서 생겨날 큰 기회가 그것이다. 가장 매력적인 비즈니스 중 일부는 바로 눈앞에 있다는 점을 일깨워 준다. 
 딜이 어떻게 성사됐는지는 에피소드에서 확인할 수 있다.
